title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 12/2015
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP-4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell XLII. Set up inside SBD perimeter area for 1st Set, mics moved onto SBD platform for 2nd Set, recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard/matrix recording of a high‑energy show featuring a stellar Playing in the Band → Crazy Fingers segue and a powerful Touch of Grey.
ai_review.review: The reviewers hail this as a master‑level recording, noting the community effort with second‑set mics that give the mix clarity and presence. Musically the concert launches with an amazing Playing in the Band into Crazy Fingers opener and sustains its momentum through a moving Touch of Grey, delivering a high‑energy performance throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 5‑star review praises both the musical performance and recording quality, indicating an exceptional show with excellent audio, but limited data prevents higher confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Community‑sourced mix using second‑set microphones on a soundboard platform; clear, balanced and highly detailed.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band → Crazy Fingers
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opener that builds momentum into a high‑energy second set; seamless transitions keep the vibe soaring.
